title: Square Motif Pattern #36
author: Spool Cotton Co., Spool Cotton #58 The Learn How Book (via freevintagecrochet.com)
notes: Public domain vintage pattern. start: original "Ch 7, join with sl st in ring." replaced by magic ring. The pattern calls its rounds '1st row', '2nd row' etc.; normalised to 'Round N:'. Intro paragraph on squaring a circle and closing remark ('This square may be made as large as desired...') omitted. Beginning ch-3 in rnds 3-5 read as dc + ch 1 (joins are made in its 2nd ch, as with the ch-2 = dc of rnd 1).
